authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3906 khura explicitly gives Bshk khur and Torwali khū foot, while section 2 *khuḍa contains retroflex khuṛ. Exact parent selection respects the survey rhotic distinction. Reviewed comparison: Bshk kʰūr “leg” (f_l4aqcljwahvyc). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10539 rakta explicitly covers both red and blood, including Bshk rat, K. rath and L. rattā. The source red/blood forms fit that semantic family; prefixed arattā needs separate ārakta comparison. Reviewed comparison: Bshk ratʰ “blood” (f_xerokhlq3oe5g). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
